item.title: Matsue Horikawa Canal Boat Tour: Around the Castle Moat — Guide
item.description: The Horikawa Sightseeing Boat is the loveliest way to experience Matsue. A small covered boat, poled and steered by a boatman who often sings, makes a slow circuit of the canals and the original moat that still rings Matsue Castle, a route unchanged for four centuries. It passes willow-lined banks, old samurai residences, stone walls and quiet backwaters, and at several points the roof of the boat has to be lowered so it can pass beneath very low historic bridges — passengers duck down with it.
